title: Bangkok
summary: Bangkok mixes gilded temples, canals, mega-malls, and phenomenal street food. It’s a gateway city with culture, nightlife, and markets that run late into the night.
bestTime: Nov–Feb is coolest and driest; hot season Mar–May; rains Jun–Oct with bursts of sunshine.

attractions.name: Grand Palace & Wat Phra Kaew
attractions.summary: Thailand’s spiritual heart; dress code enforced; arrive early.

attractions.name: Wat Pho
attractions.summary: Reclining Buddha; massage school; combine with river ferry ride.

cultureEtiquette: Dress modestly in temples; remove shoes.
Respect the monarchy and images of Buddha.
gettingAround: Use BTS/MRT for core areas; river ferries for old town.
Grab and metered taxis for late nights; beware rush-hour traffic.
Avoid unmetered tuk-tuks unless price agreed upfront.
sustainability: Carry a refillable bottle; filtered water widely available.
Use public transport or river boats to cut emissions.
Support ethical elephant and wildlife experiences only.

faqs.a: Choose busy stalls with high turnover; watch food cooked fresh.
Yes for royal temples: covered shoulders and knees.
